canDo: Can introduce yourself, your daily routine and where you live in 6–8 connected full sentences.
review: Review subject pronouns and basic word order; learn the present tense of high-frequency verbs.
input: Listening: a 60–90-second self-introduction/schedule; reading: 80–120 words of personal information or a timetable.
output: Write a 60–70-word self-introduction; speak for 60–75 seconds, retelling it without notes.
checkpoint: Only after ≥80% on the grammar questions, do the 8 output sentences; be able to correct basic errors such as je aller / nous est.
challenge: Today’s challenge: record a 60-second self-introduction in French on your phone (name, city, job or studies, your daily routine), using être, avoir, aller and faire at least once each; play it back, write down any errors you hear (such as je aller) and record it again.
